about_the_game:
Most Sudoku games are just a collection of puzzles. However, this game provides content and tools that help you improve your Sudoku skills as quickly as possible.

Note: It is NOT recommended to play this game on Steam Deck.

Note: ONLY classic Sudoku rules are supported in this game. No Sudoku variants.

Play - A Smarter, Frustration-Free Way to Solve

Tired of tedious manual entry of candidates and making mistakes? Our unique cell+skill input system revolutionizes how we play Sudoku. Simply spot a pattern like an X-Wing, select a relevant cell, click the "Fish" skill, and watch the eliminations happen automatically. No more manual candidate management or fear of errors—the game handles the work, letting you focus on the fun of solving. If the skill doesn't work in the cell, nothing will happen, making this input system completely error free. Stuck? The smart hint system will guide you to the next available technique.

Key features:

  • Select a cell and use a "skill" for efficient, error-free solving
  • Smart hint system when you're stuck
  • Full Undo/Redo functionality
  • Excellent keyboard support

Master Techniques with Partial Puzzles

Want to master a specific technique like Hidden Triple? Our partial puzzles let you practice just that. You'll get a puzzle where only that technique is needed to win. It's the most efficient way to practice specific techniques.

Analyze - Learn Advanced Techniques

Our comprehensive analysis tool helps you learn advanced techniques. It visualizes complex patterns and explains the logic behind every move, making it perfect for improving your Sudoku skills.

Paint - Create Visual Diagrams

Create and share beautiful visual diagrams of your solving strategies. Use tools to highlight cells, draw chains, add text, and export your creations.

Generate - Infinite Puzzles

Never run out of puzzles. Our generator creates fresh, high-quality Sudoku on demand, from easy to expert. You can even choose symmetry options for visually elegant puzzles.

Campaign - Learn Step by Step

New to Sudoku? Our beginner campaign teaches you the fundamentals with clear explanations, images, and targeted practice puzzles, covering essential techniques.

Supported Techniques

The game's play, analysis, and practice tools support a wide range of techniques, including:

  • Naked Sets (Naked Singles, Pairs, Triples, etc.)
  • Hidden Sets (Hidden Singles, Pairs, Triples, etc.)
  • Fish Patterns (Pointing, Claiming, X-Wing, Swordfish, Jellyfish, Finned Fish, Mutant Fish etc.)
  • XYZ-Wing Family (XY-Wing, XYZ-Wing, etc.)
  • Unique Rectangles (Types 1-4, Type 6, Hidden Unique Rectangles)
  • BUG Patterns (Bivalue Universal Grave - Types 1-4)
  • Chain Techniques (X-Chains, XY-Chains, Remote Pairs, Turbot Fish, AIC)
  • ALS Chains (Almost Locked Set Chains and Loops)
  • ALS Blossom (Almost Locked Set Blossom patterns)
  • Sue de Coq

Whether you're new to Sudoku or a seasoned expert, this game will keep you entertained!
